name: プロデューサー
trans: Mano!

name: プロデューサー
text:
よかったらこれ……
今回届いたファンレターだ
trans:
Here, it's for you...
It's the latest batch of fanletters.

name: 真乃
text:
ほわぁ……っ
こ、こんなにたくさん……
trans:
Howaa...
There's so many of them...

name: プロデューサー
text:
はは、ちょっと持ち帰れる量じゃないと思うから
必要だったら家まで運ぶよ
trans:
Haha, I think they're too many for you to bring by 
yourself, so I can help bring them too if you need it.

name: 真乃
trans: ...Thank you so much...!

name: 真乃
trans: It's the envelope with shooting stars on it...

name: プロデューサー
trans:
Eh?
Isn't that...

name: プロデューサー
trans: Ah, no, it's uh...

name: プロデューサー
text: いや、かわいい封筒だなと思って
trans: I just thought that envelope looks cute.

name: 真乃
text: はい、とっても可愛い封筒……
trans: Yes, this envelope is really cute...

name: 真乃
text: 中の手紙も大切に読みます……っ
trans: I'll also read the letter inside with all my heart...

name: プロデューサー
trans: ...Yeah.

name: 真乃
text:
……流れ星の封筒や便箋は、
たくさんいただくんですけれど
trans:
We receive a lot of fanletters with shooting stars on 
the envelope, or written with star-themed 
stationeries, but...

name: 真乃
text: どれも少しずつ違うんです
trans: All of them are a little bit different from each other.

name: 真乃
text:
封をするシールとか、文字のインクとか、
手紙の折りたたみ方とか……
trans:
Like the stickers that seals the letter, or the ink 
they use to write, or even the way they fold the 
letter...

name: 真乃
trans: That's why, I...

name: プロデューサー
trans: Yeah, that's right.

name: プロデューサー
trans: All of them are different, so...

name: プロデューサー
text: 忘れられないよな、全部
trans: There's no way you can forget about them all, right?

name: プロデューサー
trans: It seems like...

name: プロデューサー
text: 本当に、俺は気にしすぎていたんだな
trans:
It seems like I really was just thinking too much about 
it.

name: 番組ディレクター
text:
──まだ10代だから仕方ないかもしれないけど
本当に『ずっと一緒』なんて、あるわけないんだから
trans:
──It's probably fine because they're still in their 
teens, but...To me, there's no such thing as being 
'together forever'.

name: プロデューサー
text:
真乃も、灯織も、めぐるも
……ちゃんと現実を知っている
trans:
Mano, Hiori, and Meguru...
...I'm sure all of them knew the truth.

name: プロデューサー
text:
誰も口にしていないけど、
知っているし、気付いている
trans:
They don't talk about it at all, but...
They know it, and they realize it too.

name: プロデューサー
text:
流れ星の手紙が届かなくなったことも、
友達とは疎遠になってしまっただろうことも
trans:
The fact that envelope with the shooting stars 
haven't been coming recently, or how those two 
might not be friends with each other anymore.

name: off
text:
おばあちゃんになっても、
ずーっとイルミネでいたいねって！
trans:
Even if we become grannies, we want to be
together forever as Illumine!

name: プロデューサー
trans: That there's no such thing as 'forever'.

name: off
text:
……今日勉強したことを、
絶対イルミネのステージに活かします
trans:
...I'll definitely apply what I learned from here today 
for Illumine's performances.

name: プロデューサー
trans: Or that it's hard to realize something 'definitely'.

name: プロデューサー
text:
わかってて、
ただ、言わないだけ
trans:
They understand, really.
It's just, they didn't say anything.

name: プロデューサー
text: 言わないだけだったんだ
trans: They just didn't say anything, all this time.

name: 少女
text:
帰りに図書室、寄って……
今日が返却日の本……ええと……
trans:
I'll come by the... library today...
What was the book that I have to return today?
Uhh...

name: 少女
text:
あれ？
なんだっけ、このペンケース……
trans:
Huh?
What was inside this pencil case again...?

name: 少女
text: オーディオプレイヤーとイヤホン……
trans: It's my music player and earphones...

name: 少女
text:
こんなところにあったんだ……
…………
trans: So that's where I left it in...

name: 少女
text:
まだ電源つくじゃん
やば
trans:
Woah, there's still some battery in it!?
Awesome.

name: 少女
trans: Uhh, 'L' is for left, and 'R' is for right...

name: 少女
trans: It's Illumine......

name: 少女
text:
ああ……
やっぱりいいなあ……
trans:
Ah......
It's so good......

name: off
trans: Ah...

name: off
trans: This is nice...

name: off
text: うん、やっぱ新曲も最高……
trans: Yeah, the new song is really good too...

name: 少女
trans: Yep, I love this...

name: 少女
trans: I really loved this back then, huh...

name: off
text:
や、ちょっと話すより聞こ？
サビだよ、サビ
trans:
Hold on, can we just listen for now?
The verse is coming, you know.

name: off
trans: Sorry.

name: 少女
text: 一生、親友だと思ってたんだけどなあ…………
trans:
I really thought we're going to be best friends for 
life back then...

name: 少女
trans: Not that I really mind it now, though...

name: off
trans: Ah...

name: off
trans: Hmmm

name: off
trans: God, the verse is so good too...

name: off
trans: Hehee...

name: 少女
trans: Ah, it ran out of battery...

name: 少女
trans: That was amazing.

name: 少女
text: あの日に戻ったみたいだった
trans: It really felt like I went back to that day.

name: 少女
trans: I didn't know...

name: 少女
text: 歌って、時間を繋いでくれるんだ
trans: That songs can connect time like this.

name: 少女
trans: Sending me back, into that day...
